instruction: Put the blue pen in the green pen case.

attempts.code:
candidates = grasp_candidates("blue_pen")
candidate = None
for c in candidates:
    if abs(c["yaw"] - (-0.235)) < 0.1 and abs(c["height"] - 0.006) < 0.005:
        candidate = c
        break
if not candidate:
    candidate = candidates[0]

grasp(candidate)

spots = free_spots("green_case", "blue_pen")
spot = spots["spots"][0]
target_yaw = spot["object_long_axis_yaw"]
gripper_yaw_at_grasp = candidate["yaw"]
object_long_axis_at_grasp = candidate["object_long_axis_yaw"]
delta_yaw = target_yaw - object_long_axis_at_grasp + gripper_yaw_at_grasp

carry_to(spot["x"], spot["y"], height=0.18, yaw=delta_yaw)
lower_until_contact()
open_gripper()
retreat()
check("blue_pen", "green_case")
